page_title: EMP 0-1 LAZ | Empoli v Lazio 04/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) is adjudged offside.

90+5' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom left corner.
90+4' The free kick is taken by Junior Sambia (Empoli), but ball is cleared.
90+4' Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+3' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle. Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90+2' Christos Mandas steps in and intercepts a long pass from Thomas Campaniello (Empoli).
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' We are about to witness a subsitution. Thomas Campaniello (Empoli) for Mattia Viti.
89' Mattia Viti (Empoli) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
87' Matias Vecino (Lazio) has tested the patience of referee Andrea Colombo and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
86' Junior Sambia (Empoli) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Christos Mandas has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
85' Pedro (Lazio) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
84' The corner kick from Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
84' This is a yellow card! Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
83' Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
82' Junior Sambia (Empoli) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
80' The game is interrupted now, Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on. Junior Sambia (Empoli) picks up an injury.
79' Marco Baroni is forced to make a tactical change due to a red card. Nicolo Rovella will be replaced by Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio).

77' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
76' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) receives a yellow card from Andrea Colombo and because it's his second he will have an early bath.
74' The total number of attempts is 5:6. The shots on goal statistics – 1:1.

74' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
73' Pedro (Lazio) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
73' An attempted cross from Pedro (Lazio) is cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lazio.
72' Gustav Isaksen links up with Pedro (Lazio), who fires just wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
70' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Mattia Zaccagni is replaced by Pedro (Lazio).
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Luca Pellegrini will be replaced by Mario Gila (Lazio).
69' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

69' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Taty Castellanos, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception. The referee points to the corner flag and Lazio will take a corner.
67' Mattia Viti (Empoli) is penalised for a foul. Andrea Colombo had a clear view and blows his whistle.

67' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box. Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
66' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
64' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the right post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
64' The resulting corner from Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
63' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lazio.
61' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
61' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
60' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) attempts to find Mattia Viti with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
60' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
59' Ola Solbakken will be replaced by Ismael Konate (Empoli).
58' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Matias Vecino (Lazio) replaces Boulaye Dia.
56' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
53' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Empoli players look gutted.
53' Wait! Referee Andrea Colombo has indicated he is going to review the Empoli goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
52' Mattia Viti (Empoli) wins the ball inside the penalty area after the free kick and scores with a precise shot inside the right post!
51' Poor challenge! Boulaye Dia (Lazio) is penalised for tripping and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Empoli.
50' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
50' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) tries to find Ola Solbakken, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
49' The resulting corner from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is cleared.
49' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The linesman makes the right call and Lazio will have a corner.
48' Junior Sambia (Empoli) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Adam Marusic (Lazio) is replaced by Gustav Isaksen.
46' Half-time substitution. Roberto D'Aversa decided to make a change. Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) is replaced by Junior Sambia.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) meets a cross from Luca Pellegrini, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes high over the crossbar.
45+2' The referee is firm and issues Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) a deserved yellow card.
45+1' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) serves up a nice cross, but Christos Mandas punches the ball away.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Mattia Zaccagni plays a nice corner into the middle of the box, Adam Marusic (Lazio) is first to react but his headed effort is way off the mark and goes well wide of the left post.
44' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

43' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach easily deals with the threat. Lazio force their opponents to concede a corner.
42' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
39' Samuel Gigot (Lazio) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
38' RED CARD! Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) will not finish today's game. The second caution means he can have an early bath.
37' Christos Mandas leaps to intercept the corner kick from Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli).

36' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play and Empoli have been awarded a corner kick.
34' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
33' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play.
32' Referee Andrea Colombo sees the trip by Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Free kick. Lazio will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
30' The Empoli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
23' The fouls committed statistics – 2:0.

22' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Andrea Colombo stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Lazio have been awarded a free kick.
20' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
20' Lazio keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
18' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Empoli will have a throw-in.
17' Matteo Guendouzi slips the ball to Taty Castellanos (Lazio), who hastily shoots from distance and sends the ball well wide of the left post.
15' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) sends a long cross over to Taty Castellanos, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach comes forward to gather the ball.
14' Luca Marianucci (Empoli) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads under the crossbar, but is stopped by a great save from Christos Mandas.
12' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) takes a short corner kick.
12' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lazio.
10' Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
10' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out for a corner. Empoli can continue in their attacking effort.
10' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
9' Christos Mandas (Lazio) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
6' Christos Mandas (Lazio) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
6' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle and it's Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
4' Adam Marusic (Lazio) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
3' Adam Marusic (Lazio) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
1' 0 - 1 Goal! Elseid Hysaj sends a precise cross into the box, Boulaye Dia (Lazio) latches on to it and puts the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
1' The match has just started.
Lazio will kick the game off.
Andrea Colombo is introduced as the referee for today's match.
